items.title: Quick Ludo 先吃后冲线

source_rules.门槛: 快速模式吃1子才能进终点
source_rules.回报: 一子完成即胜；经典全子

evidence_refs.quote:
1. In Quick Mode, you can enter the finish track only after killing 1 piece of any other player

2. A player who throws 6 can move, and gets another chance to throw the dice. If a player throws 6 three consecutive times, the round ends. 

3. Players who steps on an opponent can eliminate the opponent, forcing them back to base, while the player gets another chance to throw the dice. 

4. Player can reach the finish only when they throw the number for the fixed point, and get another chance to throw the dice. 

5. Players who earn 'gold dice' must throw 6. 

6. Players who earn the 'magnet' can advance 8 steps until others block them 

7. Players who earn the 'bomb' can bomb 8 steps, eliminating the opponent back to the base 

8. All pieces should reach the finish in a classic competition, and only one piece should reach the finish in a quick competition. 
9. When the game is over, the more pieces that reach the finish, and 
the farther the pieces that haven't reached the finish are, the higher the rank.

items.source_loop: 至少吃一子→获得进终点资格→一子到终点获胜

items.implemented_scope: 吃子资格与终局状态机；专属操作：移动4格吃对手 → 精确走到本地12格终点

source_rules.时序: 沙特时间日0点、周一0点结算
source_rules.回报: 限定礼物、兑换物、榜单奖励

evidence_refs.quote:
1. Every time you participate in the Wishing Fountain lottery, you will receive a reward, and the reward will be automatically placed in your backpack.
2. The gifts in the Wishing Fountain are limited gifts. You can only get this gift by drawing in the Wishing Fountain.
3. Obtain gift fragments and noble fragments, which can be used in the happy exchange house.
4. The daily list settlement time is from 00:00 on the same day to 00:00 the next day, saudi time, and the weekly list settlement time is from monday 00:00 on monday to 00:00 on the next monday, saudi time. ranking rewards will be automatically distributed after settlement.
5. This gameplay has nothing to do with apple.
6. The final interpretation right of this gameplay belongs to the platform.
